finding.headline: "I Did Crunches at 4 Weeks and Made It Worse"
finding.problem: "Instagram said 'get your body back.' I pushed too hard, my belly domed, and I peed myself laughing. I don't know what's safe anymore."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
